prompt_text: Using attached three-object labeled source contact sheet, create transparent orthographic atlas EXACTLY 6 columns by 3 rows in source order. Columns FRONT, TOP, RIGHT SIDE, LEFT SIDE, BOTTOM, REAR. These are flat dirt road terrain tiles: TOP/BOTTOM are square plan views showing each exact road shape and orientation. FRONT/REAR/RIGHT/LEFT are broad horizontal thin ground-edge elevation strips of the tile thickness, never narrow vertical strips or perspective. Preserve the straight, curve, T-junction, crossroads, endcap or slope road layout and dirt/stone texture in matching row; do not rotate object between views. Axis-aligned orthographic, no foreshortening. Each full tile centered entirely inside its cell with generous transparent margin, no overlap or row leakage. Transparent background, no scenery, shadows, labels, text, grid lines or borders. Unseen surfaces inferred.
